Messages.Author: James B. Floate
Messages.Body:
Ahh LSJ,
just a quickie,
Slaughtering the Herd says "...he or she moves one blood to this acting
vampire." I take it that if the vampire doesnt have the blood to move it
simply doesnt pay and carries on with the action, just thought id clear
it up. I really wish they could keep consistent wording schemes.

Thanks,
James B.
